name: Diego Brando Twisted Fate

description:
The skin includes multiple voicelines when walking, dying, doing any of the Ctrl's, Q, W and R. Any questions/whatever, just message me on discord: Manito.0

The voicelines are from the game JJBA Eyes of Heaven. Voice acted by Takehito Koyasu. From the 3 musics on the CTRL + 3, two of them are from the games Eyes of Heaven and All Star Battle R. The third one is Scary Monsters - David Bowie.
